title: travel_expense scenario fixture cannot be installed on main: install-local answers 422 state-machine-no-initial-states
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed as a `finding` by seat `repo:objectstack#2` from the #36490 dev report (7083592804). Not triaged; not claimed.

## What

On `main` (measured at 69c95116d), `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` with the committed fixture `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json` answers `422 INVALID_METADATA`. The failures are:

- `objects.demotravel_expense_claim.validations[0]` — `[state-machine-no-initial-states]`
- the same rule on `demotravel_approval_step`

The install rolls back, so the scenario card's own fixture cannot be installed on the current tree. The published 18.6.0 server installs it. With the three `state_machine` validations removed, the install answers 200.

The rule is `STATE_MACHINE_NO_INITIAL_STATES` in `packages/lint/src/validate-inert-object-declarations.ts`.

## Why it matters

An eval round built with `--packages workspace` (as the ask rounds are) cannot install this card's build. Either the fixture declares state machines that the platform now refuses, or the rule refuses a legitimate shape. Triage decides which side is wrong.

## Re-check

Boot a host from `main`, then `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` with `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`. It is still present while the answer is 422 naming `state-machine-no-initial-states`.
